title: Ambient (outdoor) air pollution — fact sheet
claims: In 2019, 99% of the world's population lived in places where the WHO air quality guideline levels were not met.
Ambient outdoor air pollution was estimated to cause 4.2 million premature deaths worldwide in 2019.

Of the outdoor air pollution related premature deaths in 2019, 68% were due to ischaemic heart disease and stroke, 14% to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, 14% to acute lower respiratory infections and 4% to lung cancers.
89% of the 4.2 million premature deaths occurred in low- and middle-income countries.
Most sources of outdoor air pollution are well beyond the control of individuals and require action at policy level.
